FX-COFFSET-001.says: All phases 0, the settings as they start: the drawing, untouched.

FX-COFFSET-002.says: Red phase 90, wrap: red raised a quarter of the range, and what passes white comes round from black, so the reddest colours turn dark red.

FX-COFFSET-003.says: Red 90, green 180, blue 270, wrap: each channel turned its own way, the colours scrambled into new ones.

FX-COFFSET-004.says: All three -90, wrap: every value lowered a quarter, and what passes black comes round from white, so the darks turn light.

FX-COFFSET-005.says: All three 180, solarize: values below half rise by half, values above half are folded back down from white.

FX-COFFSET-006.says: All three 360, solarize: one whole turn folds every value over, the picture's negative.

FX-COFFSET-007.says: All three 720, solarize: two turns bring the picture back.

FX-COFFSET-008.says: All three 180, polarize: like FX-COFFSET-005 but smooth, with no sharp fold at white.

FX-COFFSET-009.says: All three 360, polarize: one whole turn is the negative, as solarize's.

FX-COFFSET-010.says: Red 45, green -135, blue 600, polarize: each channel its own way round.

FX-COFFSET-011.says: Red phase keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 400 at frame 4, linear, wrap: frame 0 untouched, frame 2 red 200, frame 4 red 400.

FX-COFFSET-012.says: FX-COFFSET-003 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-COFFSET-013.says: Red phase 3601, above 3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COFFSET-014.says: Blue phase -3601, below -3600. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COFFSET-015.says: Overflow "mirror", which is not one. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-COFFSET-016.says: Overflow "Wrap": the word is exact, so a capital is not it. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
